projects.title: Quadruped Robot
bullets: Revised the robot chassis from 160 to 225 mm and shortened the upper leg links from 143 to 135 mm to fit the servos.
The team assembled four legs and actuated one; walking control remains in development.

sources.text: Extended the chassis from 160 to 225 mm and shortened the upper leg link from 143 to 135 mm in CAD.
The collaborative build record documents four legs attached and one leg actuated.
The CAD packages all four legs below the body; physical folding validation is next.

projects.title: Volumetric Display
bullets: The revised CAD replaces a broad rotating wall with 20 radial supports.
Preliminary arm analysis showed about 23 psi at a modeled 0.28 lbf load; this is not a validated operating limit.

sources.text: Replaced the broad rotating wall with twenty radial supports in the revised CAD model.
A preliminary arm model reports about 23 psi peak stress under a 0.28 lbf modeled load.
Split the center shaft into printable sections for the Prusa Mini build envelope.
The shaft analysis notebook specifies approximately 4,500 degrees per second as a model input.

projects.title: FEA & GD&T
bullets: The preliminary assembly model applies separate -200 lbf Y-direction loads to two aligner plates.
The study examines stress around holes, cutout corners, and spacers; model validation and toleranced drawings are next.

sources.text: Modeled separate −200 lbf Y-direction force inputs on the two selected plates.
Examined stress-contour variation around holes, cutout corners, and spacer interfaces.
Next steps are to resolve model warnings, check mesh sensitivity, and define critical fits in a toleranced drawing.

projects.title: SolidWorks CAD to Manufacturing Readiness
bullets: Practiced parametric CAD using the official SolidWorks CSWA problem set.
Next steps are to develop selected parts into GD&T drawings and review their manufacturability and assembly.

sources.text: Working through the official SolidWorks CSWA practice problem set to develop CAD fluency.
Extending selected practice parts toward GD&T drawings and DFM/DFA reviews.

projects.title: Sprocket · VEX Pushback
bullets: Led chassis and intake design in Onshape.
Built the pneumatic tongue and redesigned sensor mounts to fit tracking hardware within the robot envelope.

sources.text: Led chassis and intake development in Onshape.
Developed the pneumatic tongue and redesigned sensor mounts to integrate tracking hardware within the robot envelope.
The team’s final recorded trial scored 60 points: 45 driver and 15 autonomous, above its 50-point target.
The team earned the Judge’s Award and documented the robot in a CAD assembly and engineering notebook.

projects.title: Launch Vehicle Project
bullets: Led core calculations, trajectory simulation, and structural analysis for a student launch-vehicle concept.
Used MATLAB to develop staging parameters for a target payload of 4,500 lb; the vehicle remained a concept.

sources.text: Led the concept’s core calculations, trajectory simulations, and structural analysis for the student team.
Used MATLAB to develop staging parameters for a concept targeting a 4,500 lb satellite payload.
Developed a bulkhead-sizing spreadsheet that compares calculated stress with material allowable stress.

projects.title: High Stakes Competition Robot Build
bullets: Contributed CAD and led assembly of the team’s competition robot.
The team revised ground pickup and added a conveyor bracket to stabilize mobile-goal capture.

sources.text: Contributed CAD and led assembly for the team’s competition robot.
The team revised ground pickup and added a bracket below the conveyor to stabilize mobile-goal capture.
Across seven match trials, the team’s highest recorded result was 12 points in Trial 6.

projects.title: Arduino Electronics
bullets: Designed and built an eight-key musical keyboard prototype on an Arduino Uno.
Used a resistor ladder on analog pin A0 to distinguish key presses and map voltage ranges to tones.

sources.text: Designed and prototyped an eight-key musical keyboard on an Arduino Uno.
Used a resistor ladder to read the keyboard through analog input A0 and map voltage ranges to tones.
The project documents four preparatory Arduino tutorials across 31 notebook pages.

projects.title: Tower Design Project
bullets: Handled design and notebook work, rebuilding the AutoCAD model when the original file was unavailable.
The team’s tower held 45 lb before failure, but bending at 67 N left the stated 100 N criterion unmet.

sources.text: Handled design and notebook work and rebuilt the AutoCAD model when the original file was unavailable.
The team’s tower held 45 lb before failure, while visible bending at 67 N left the stated 100 N criterion unmet.
Proposed diagonal bracing between layers to address twisting in a next iteration.

projects.title: Sensor Challenge
bullets: Contributed build work and notebook documentation to two sensor-guided robot challenges.
The team robot avoided obstacles and completed the warehouse course in four of five recorded runs.

sources.text: Contributed notebook and build work to the two sensor-guided robot challenges.
The team robot avoided obstacles and finished the warehouse course in four of five runs.
After motor-power tuning, the robot completed a clean parallel park on the seventh trial.

projects.title: Putt-Putt Boat: Straight-Line Redesign
bullets: Added twin paper-straw exhaust extensions to a class-built boat to improve straight-line travel.
Used a removable wooden spacer to hold the exhaust spacing and angle while the adhesive set.

sources.text: Independently added twin paper-straw exhaust extensions to a class-built boat for straighter travel.
Used a removable wooden spacer to hold straw spacing and angle while the adhesive set.
Five trials over a 33-inch course averaged about 13.7 seconds, compared with the recorded 33.07-second baseline.

projects.title: Wind Turbine Competition
bullets: Produced notebook drawings to document the team’s blade-development process.
The March 16 prototype used three cardboard blades, each 14 inches long and 3 inches wide.

sources.text: Produced notebook drawings documenting the blade development process.
